_doc: Proving Grounds (U1, docs/COMMUNITY_UPDATES.md). Drills teach one mechanic each against scripted bots (server/bot_brain.gd config); exams are duels against the instructor. Bot config keys: mode (fight, cycle, flee, freezer, telegraph, passive), reaction_ticks, prayer_accuracy (0-1), pray (bool), eat_hp, eat_delay (ticks it waits after eating before attacking), fake_switch_chance (0-1), spec_hp (target HP at or below which it specs), spec_chance (0-1), attack_range (tiles, 0 = weapon range), damage_mult, cycle_every (attacks per style in 'cycle'), telegraph_ticks, walk (bool). Kits: 'bracket' + kit key (melee/ranged/magic/hybrid), or 'player' for the player's selected class mapped into the bracket. xp is split evenly across the three styles and granted on the first pass only.

instructor.name: Drillmaster Varn
instructor.desc: A scarred veteran of the frontier wars who now trains recruits at the Proving Grounds.

drills.name: Wards
drills.desc: The sparring partner changes style every few attacks. Switch your ward (keys 1/2/3) to match each attack before it lands.

drills.name: Freezes
drills.desc: First, freeze the runner with a freeze spell. Then the freezer comes for you: get more than 10 tiles away without being frozen.

drills.name: Special attacks
drills.desc: Wear the target down, then press E to arm your special attack and land it once the target is at or below 50% HP. Then land a special attack on a frozen target. Your special energy refills in this drill.

drills.name: Gear switching
drills.desc: Switch your weapon, body and legs to another style in a single tick, three times. Click fast or use Z / X / C.

drills.name: Combo eating
drills.desc: Three bursts are coming, each nearly lethal. Survive all three. After a burst, eat main food, combo food and a brew in the same tick.

drills.name: Reading the enemy
drills.desc: The duelist swaps weapons, then attacks a moment later. Call the style before the attack lands: 8 melee, 9 ranged, 0 magic.

exams.name: Graduation
exams.label: learning
exams.desc: A fair fight against Drillmaster Varn. If you passed the drills, you can win this. First to 2 rounds.

exams.name: Instructor's Challenge
exams.label: aspirational
exams.desc: Varn fights like a seasoned PvPer: fast wards, fake switches, sharp specs. Meant for players who are already PvP-ready.

dummy.name: Training dummy room
dummy.desc: Hit the dummy and see live accuracy, max hit and damage per tick for your loadout and prayers. Uses the real combat formulas.
